summary: Full backend + UI verification of Bearer-token (localStorage) auth fix for the cross-origin preview iframe. 14/14 pytest cases pass, including 6 new Bearer-only-auth tests proving /api/auth/me, /api/dashboard/summary and /api/fees succeed with ONLY 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and an empty cookie jar. Browser E2E confirms: login lands on Dashboard (no bounce); io_access_token (215-char JWT) stored in localStorage; after page.context.clear_cookies() AND a reload of '/', the dashboard still loads (Bearer-from-localStorage works exactly as designed for the cross-origin iframe); in-browser fetch('/api/auth/me', {credentials:'omit', Authorization: 'Bearer ...'}) returns 200 with the correct email; logout clears io_access_token, redirects to /login, and revisiting '/' redirects back to /login. Fees regression: data-testid 'waive-late-fee-613' now matches WITHOUT trailing space (count=1, dirty variant count=0), Late Fees stat=$34.59, Total Due=$916.59, Late Fee column present, Unit 613 row shows $34.59 + WAIVE.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is now dual-mode: cookies (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=none) AND Bearer-token from localStorage key 'io_access_token'. The login response body contains access_token. Frontend axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js attaches Authorization Bearer from localStorage on every request, and 401 handler removes the token and triggers onUnauthorized() to redirect to /login. Tests at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_fees.py cover both auth paths (14 tests, all passing). Useful UI selectors: login-form, login-email, login-password, login-submit, dashboard-page, nav-fees, fees-page, fee-year (input), fee-month (NATIVE <select> — use page.select_option(..., '3') for March), fees-stat-latefees, fees-stat-total-due, waive-late-fee-613 (now clean, no trailing space). Sign-out trigger is a button with text 'Sign out' or data-testid 'logout-button' / 'sign-out'.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: in the production cross-origin preview iframe (homeowner-hub-11.preview.emergentagent.com embedded in a different origin), modern browsers block third-party cookies, so the SameSite=None;Secure cookie from iteration_8 still wasn't always delivered with subsequent /auth/me calls. Fix: switch to Bearer-token auth in addition to cookies. Backend /api/auth/login returns access_token in the body; backend get_current_user already falls back to the Authorization: Bearer header (server.py:280-285). Frontend stores access_token in localStorage under 'io_access_token' (AuthContext.jsx:42) and attaches it via an axios request interceptor (lib/api.js:16-23) on every request, so cookies are not required. Verified: page.context.clear_cookies() followed by reload still loads the dashboard, and an in-browser fetch with credentials:'omit' and Authorization Bearer returns the authenticated user. Logout clears both: it calls /api/auth/logout (clears cookies server-side) and localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY). The fix is complete and confirmed end-to-end.
